editorial:
Imagine you are living your best life in a quiet LA suburb, just relaxing with your family. That is exactly where you find Bobby, an ex-Navy SEAL who has traded his gear for landscaping tools. He has a great wife and a teenage daughter, and everything feels peaceful. When their flashy new neighbors, Clay and Elise, invite them out to a trendy downtown club, it seems like a fun night of partying. But you quickly realize that the vibe is off. What starts as a simple night out turns into a scary fight for survival as they end up in the wrong part of town with the wrong people.

You will love seeing Bobby switch back into soldier mode to protect his family. The action is punchy, and the tension builds up fast, though some of the dialogue feels a bit cheesy at times. It is a solid choice if you want something that keeps you on your toes without being too complicated. If you can find it streaming in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, go for that for the best picture. Otherwise, renting it on Apple TV is a great way to see if you like it before adding the Blu-ray to your physical collection.
endingExplained: After a wild night of fighting and dodging criminals, Bobby uses his special forces training to outsmart the bad guys. He manages to protect Dawn and Brianna from the dangerous gang they crossed. In the final showdown, Bobby takes down the main villains in a series of intense fights. The movie wraps up with the family safe, though they are forever changed by the nightmare, and they realize their new neighbors were not who they seemed.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves action movies where a skilled dad has to save his family from a bad situation.
